Students gain hands-on experience in patient care, midwifery, community health nursing, and medical-surgical practice, preparing them for careers in government hospitals, private healthcare, and international nursing roles.

title: BA LLB (Hons.)
description: BA LLB (Hons.) is a five-year integrated law program that combines legal education with humanities and social sciences. Students gain a strong foundation in constitutional law, criminal law, civil law and legal research through practical exposure, moot courts and internships.

title: BBA LLB (Hons.)
description: BBA LLB (Hons.) integrates legal studies with business administration to prepare students for careers in corporate law, legal consulting and business governance. The program combines legal theory with practical learning through moot courts, internships and industry interaction.

title: LLB (Hons.)
description: LLB (Hons.) is a three-year law degree designed for graduates who wish to pursue a legal career. The program develops expertise in constitutional law, criminal law, civil law, legal drafting and advocacy while providing practical exposure through moot courts and internships.

title: LLM
description: LLM is a one-year postgraduate law program for graduates seeking advanced legal expertise. Students can specialize in Intellectual Property and Technology Law, International Investment and Commercial Arbitration, Environmental Law and Climate Justice, Construction Law and Practice, or Constitutional Law and Governance while engaging in advanced legal research and dissertation work.

title: B.Com (Hons.)
description: A 3-year B.Com (Hons.) degree covering accounting, economics, business law, and taxation at Graphic Era, Dehradun, with strong placements and pathways to CA, MBA, and M.Com.

title: B.Com (Hons.) with Research
description: Combines the commerce curriculum with research methodology and a guided dissertation, mentored by faculty from IIMs and IITs. Ideal for M.Com, PhD, and analytics or consulting careers.

title: B.Com (Hons.) International Finance and Accounting with ACCA, UK
bullets: Career pathways to Industry Leading Companies
description: B.Com integrated with the ACCA (UK) qualification. IFRS, international taxation, and audit built into the degree. One of the few B.Com with ACCA programs in North India, opening global careers with Big 4 firms and multinational finance teams.

title: B.Com (Hons.) Banking & Finance
description: A specialised commerce degree in banking operations, financial markets, investment, and risk management. This prepares students for careers in banking, NBFCs, fintech, and wealth management.

title: B.Com (Hons.) Accounting, Auditing & Taxation
description: In-depth training in financial accounting, auditing, GST, and direct taxation with practical compliance exposure. A strong launchpad for CA, CMA, audit firms, and tax consultancy careers.

title: B.Com (Hons.) Corporate Accounting and Financial Analysis with CMA, US
description: B.Com integrated with the CMA (US) certification, focused on corporate accounting, cost management, and financial analysis — a globally recognised credential for careers in MNCs, consulting, and strategic finance.

title: B.Com (Hons.) Integrated with US CPA in Corporate Finance
description: This program combines a B.Com (Hons.) degree with the US CPA pathway, covering US GAAP, corporate finance, financial reporting, and assurance. Graduates earn a globally respected public accounting credential alongside their degree.

title: B.Voc BFSI
description: B.Voc BFSI is a 3-year vocational degree designed for job-readiness in the banking, financial services, and insurance sector. With practical training, industry internships, and placement support, students move directly into roles in banking operations, insurance, NBFCs, and fintech.

title: B.Com (Hons.) in Financial Analytics and Business Intelligence
description: A future-focused B.Com (Hons.) program that combines core commerce subjects with business analytics, artificial intelligence, and data analysis. Students develop skills in data-driven decision-making, visualization, and financial modelling, preparing them for high-demand careers in business analytics, fintech, consulting, and finance operations.

title: BHM
bullets: Hands-on practical exposure in kitchens and services
description: BHM is a comprehensive undergraduate program focused on hotel operations, food production, front office, housekeeping, and hospitality management. It combines classroom learning with practical training and internships in top hotels, preparing students for careers in the global hospitality and tourism industry.

title: Hotel Operations
bullets: Focus on front office and guest handling
Quick entry into hotel industry roles
description: Hotel Operations focuses on the core functional areas of the hospitality industry including front office, housekeeping, food and beverage service, and guest handling. This program is ideal for students seeking hands-on training and quick entry into hotel and service roles.

title: Diploma in Hotel Management (Industry Integrated)
description: This industry-integrated diploma program combines classroom learning with real-time hotel training. Students gain practical exposure through internships and live projects, making them job-ready for operational roles in hotels, resorts, and hospitality chains.

title: B.Sc. in Hotel Management
bullets: Strong foundation in hospitality and tourism
Culinary arts and hotel administration training
description: B.Sc. in Hotel Management provides a strong academic and practical foundation in hospitality, covering hotel administration, culinary arts, customer service, and tourism management. The program prepares students for supervisory and managerial roles in the hospitality sector.

title: Certificate Course in Hotel Operations (CCHO)
description: The Certificate Course in Hotel Operations (CCHO) is a short-term program designed to develop essential hospitality skills such as guest service, housekeeping basics, and food service operations. It is ideal for quick skill development and entry-level job opportunities.

title: Executive Development Program in Hospitality Management
bullets: Designed for professionals and career growth
description: This executive program is designed for professionals and aspiring leaders in the hospitality industry. It focuses on advanced management skills, leadership, operations strategy, and service excellence required for senior roles in hotels and global hospitality organizations.

title: MHM
description: MHM is a postgraduate program that focuses on advanced hospitality management, strategic operations, leadership, and global hospitality trends. It prepares students for managerial and leadership roles in hotels, resorts, airlines, and international tourism organizations.

title: B.Sc (Hons.) Biotechnology
description: A three-year honours science degree exploring how living systems can be engineered for medicine, agriculture and industry. You build strong lab skills in genetics, molecular biology and microbiology and complete a research project, preparing for roles in biotech, pharma, research labs and higher studies.

title: B.Sc (Hons.) Forensic Science
description: A three-year honours degree that applies science to criminal investigation. You learn evidence collection, forensic biology, chemistry, toxicology and document examination in dedicated labs, preparing for careers in forensic laboratories, law enforcement support and investigative agencies.

title: M.Sc Bioinformatics
description: A two-year postgraduate program at the meeting point of biology and computing. You learn to analyse genomic and biological data using programming and computational tools, completing a research dissertation that prepares you for roles in genomics, pharma, biotech analytics and research.

title: M.Sc Biotechnology
description: A two-year postgraduate program that deepens expertise in molecular biology, genomics and bioprocessing. Through advanced lab work and a research dissertation, you prepare for careers in biotechnology research, pharmaceuticals, R&D and doctoral study.

title: B.Sc (Hons.) Microbiology
description: A three-year honours degree that takes microbiology deeper into molecular, medical and industrial applications. With advanced lab training and a research project, you prepare for specialised roles in research, diagnostics, biotech and pharmaceutical industries.

title: B.Sc Microbiology
description: A three-year science degree exploring microorganisms and their role in health, industry and the environment. You gain hands-on skills in microbial culture, staining and analysis, building a foundation for careers in diagnostics, food and pharma industries, and further study.

title: M.Sc Microbiology
description: A two-year postgraduate program covering medical, industrial and environmental microbiology in depth. Through advanced techniques and a research dissertation, you prepare for careers in research labs, healthcare, food and pharma industries, and doctoral study.

title: B.Sc Food Technology
description: A three-year science degree covering how food is processed, preserved and kept safe. You gain practical skills in food chemistry, quality control and processing technology, preparing for roles in the food and beverage industry, quality assurance and product development.

title: B.Sc (Hons.) Food Technology
description: A three-year honours degree that takes food technology deeper into processing engineering, safety systems and product innovation. With a research project and industry exposure, you prepare for specialised roles in food manufacturing, R&D, quality assurance and further study.

title: B.Sc Nutrition & Dietetics
description: A three-year science degree focused on nutrition, health and therapeutic diets. You learn how food supports the body and how to plan diets for different needs, with practical training that prepares you for careers as a nutritionist, dietitian or wellness professional.

title: B.Sc. (Hons.) Nutrition & Dietetics
description: A three-year honours degree that deepens the study of clinical, therapeutic and public health nutrition. With a research project and clinical internships, you prepare for specialised roles in hospitals, wellness, the food industry and nutrition research.

title: M.Sc Foods & Nutrition
bullets: Clinical, public health and sports nutrition
description: A two-year postgraduate program advancing expertise across clinical, community and sports nutrition. Through research and a dissertation, you prepare for senior roles in dietetics, public health, the food industry, research and academia.

title: M.Sc Food Technology
description: A two-year postgraduate program advancing expertise in food science, processing and safety. Through research and a dissertation, you prepare for senior roles in food manufacturing, R&D, quality management and the wider food and beverage industry.

title: M.Sc Chemistry
bullets: Specialization in organic or inorganic chemistry
description: A two-year postgraduate program with specialization in organic or inorganic chemistry. You gain advanced analytical and instrumentation skills and complete a research dissertation, preparing for careers in chemical and pharma industries, research labs, quality control and doctoral study.

title: M.Sc EVS
description: A two-year postgraduate program on the science of environmental systems and sustainability. You study ecology, pollution control, climate and environmental management with fieldwork and research, preparing for roles in environmental consulting, regulatory bodies, NGOs and research.

title: B.Sc Geology
description: A three-year science degree exploring the Earth, its materials and processes. You study minerals, rocks, structures and surface processes with regular fieldwork, building a foundation for careers in mining, groundwater, environment and geological surveys.

title: B.Sc (Hons.) Geology
bullets: Petrology, structural geology and remote sensing
description: A three-year honours degree that takes geology deeper into petrology, structural geology and remote sensing. With a research project and extensive fieldwork, you prepare for specialised roles in mineral exploration, hydrogeology, environment and further study.

title: M.Sc Applied Geology
description: A two-year postgraduate program focused on the applied side of earth science, from mineral and groundwater exploration to remote sensing and GIS. Through fieldwork and a research dissertation, you prepare for careers in mining, oil and gas, hydrogeology, environment and geological surveys.

title: B.A. (Hons.) Economics
description: A three-year honours degree building strong foundations in economic theory, data and policy. You study micro, macro and development economics alongside statistics and econometrics, preparing for careers in banking, analytics, policy, civil services and postgraduate study.

title: B.A. (Hons.) English
description: A three-year honours degree exploring literature, language and critical thinking across periods and cultures. You develop strong reading, writing and analytical skills, preparing for careers in content, media, publishing, teaching, civil services and postgraduate study.

title: B.A. (Hons.) Psychology
description: A three-year honours degree exploring the science of mind and behaviour. You study cognitive, social and developmental psychology with practical labs and research methods, preparing for careers in counselling, HR, research and postgraduate study in psychology.

title: B.A. (Hons.) Political Science
description: A three-year honours degree covering political theory, governance, international relations and public policy. You build strong analytical and writing skills, preparing for careers in civil services, law, journalism, policy, research and postgraduate study.

title: B.A. (Hons.) Sociology
description: A three-year honours degree examining how societies, cultures and institutions work. You learn social theory and research methods with fieldwork, preparing for careers in social research, development, civil services, HR, media and postgraduate study.

title: B.A.
bullets: Choose from arts and humanities subjects
description: A three-year undergraduate degree offering a broad foundation across the arts and humanities. You combine subjects such as English, economics, political science and sociology while building strong communication and analytical skills, opening paths to civil services, media, teaching, management and postgraduate study.

title: M.A. Applied Psychology
description: A two-year postgraduate program applying psychology to real settings, from clinical and counselling to organisational contexts. With practicum training and a research dissertation, you prepare for roles in counselling, mental health, human resources, research and academia.

title: M.A. Sociology
description: A two-year postgraduate program advancing social theory and research methodology. Through fieldwork and a dissertation, you prepare for careers in social research, policy, development organisations, academia and the public sector.

title: M.A. English
description: A two-year postgraduate program advancing the study of literature, theory and criticism. Through research and a dissertation, you prepare for careers in academia, writing, media, publishing, teaching and the wider creative and knowledge industries.

title: M.A. Economics
description: A two-year postgraduate program deepening economic theory, quantitative methods and policy analysis. Through research and a dissertation, you prepare for careers in economics, banking, research, public policy, analytics and academia.

title: M.A. Political Science
description: A two-year postgraduate program deepening political theory, governance and international relations. Through research and a dissertation, you prepare for careers in civil services, policy research, academia, journalism and the development sector.

title: B.Sc Nursing
bullets: Covering anatomy, physiology, pharmacology and community health
Hands-on clinical training in hospitals and healthcare settings
Prepares graduates for nursing careers in government hospitals, private healthcare and abroad
description: B.Sc Nursing is a 4-year undergraduate program combining theoretical nursing science with extensive clinical training. Students gain hands-on experience in patient care, midwifery, community health nursing, and medical-surgical practice, preparing them for careers in government hospitals, private healthcare, and international nursing roles.

title: Bachelor of Medical Laboratory Technology (BMLT)
bullets: Diagnostic lab techniques: haematology, microbiology, biochemistry and pathology
Practice in clinical laboratory settings with modern diagnostic equipment
Careers in hospitals, diagnostic centres, blood banks and research labs
description: BMLT is a 3.5-year undergraduate program in medical laboratory technology, training students in diagnostic procedures across haematology, biochemistry, microbiology, and clinical pathology. Graduates are equipped to work in hospital labs, diagnostic centres, blood banks, and public health laboratories across India and abroad.

title: Bachelor of Medical Radiotherapy Technology (BMRIT)
bullets: Training in X-ray, MRI, CT scan, ultrasound and nuclear imaging techniques
Hands-on clinical exposure with modern radiology and diagnostic imaging equipment
Careers in hospitals, radiology departments, diagnostic labs and imaging centres
description: BMRIT is a 3.5-year program in medical radiology and imaging technology, covering radiographic procedures, MRI, CT scanning, ultrasound, and radiation safety. Graduates work as radiologic technologists in hospitals, diagnostic imaging centres, and nuclear medicine departments.

title: B.Sc Operation Theatre
bullets: Training in surgical instrumentation, sterilisation, anaesthesia support and OT management
Hands-on clinical practice in live operation theatre environments
Careers as operation theatre technicians in hospitals and surgical centres
description: B.Sc Operation Theatre Technology is a 3.5-year program preparing students for roles in surgical and perioperative care. The curriculum covers OT setup, sterilisation protocols, surgical instrumentation, anaesthesia assistance, and patient safety, equipping graduates for careers in hospitals, nursing homes, and day-care surgical units.

title: Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT)
bullets: Training in musculoskeletal, neurological, cardiopulmonary and sports physiotherapy
Supervised clinical internships in hospitals, rehabilitation units and sports injury clinics
Careers as physiotherapists in hospitals, sports teams, geriatric care and private practice
description: BPT is a 4.5-year undergraduate program including a 6-month compulsory internship, covering the full spectrum of physiotherapy practice—musculoskeletal rehabilitation, neurological physiotherapy, paediatric care, and sports injury management. Graduates practice as registered physiotherapists in hospitals, rehabilitation centres, sports academies, and community health settings.

title: B.Sc Cardiovascular Technology
bullets: Training in ECG, echocardiography and cardiac diagnostics
Clinical exposure in cath labs, cardiac ICUs and cardiology departments
Careers in hospitals, heart institutes and diagnostic centres
description: B.Sc Cardiovascular Technology is a 3.5-year undergraduate program that prepares students to assist in the diagnosis and treatment of cardiovascular diseases. The curriculum covers cardiac anatomy and physiology, electrocardiography (ECG), echocardiography, stress testing (TMT), cardiac catheterization procedures, and advanced diagnostic techniques. Through extensive clinical training in hospitals and cardiac care centres, students develop the technical expertise required to work alongside cardiologists in delivering high-quality cardiac care. Graduates can pursue rewarding careers as cardiovascular technologists in hospitals, heart institutes, diagnostic centres, and critical care units.
